verdict.rationale: Sierra offers overlapping capabilities—Agent Checks/Simulations to catch problems proactively, Insights tracking CSAT/resolution metrics, Explorer for investigating real conversations, and merge-approval human-in-the-loop release governance—that together approximate an ongoing QA and fix-back loop. However, there's no explicit description of a structured 'scored samples' QA process (e.g., a QA rubric, sampling methodology, or explicit failure-flagging queue) tying directly into a fix pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit QA sampling/scoring workflow, an explicit failure-flagging mechanism distinct from real-time checks, and independent evidence the review loop concretely feeds fixes back into the agent.
